sys_hub_action_type_definition.annotation: Collect data for use later in the flow.
sys_hub_action_type_definition.description:
Creates a new flow data record. This may be used to capture inputs from the user during flow execution.

Inputs:

  • Definition - Flow Data Definition that defines the inputs to gather.
  • Assigned To - (Optional) User required to provide flow data inputs.
  • Automated - When checked, does not wait for flow data to be in a completed state.

Outputs:

  • Record - Flow Data Record created.
  • Data - Data Definition inputs collected by Flow Data record
